requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the prescaler value to IWDG_PR.PR when requested by the caller.
requirements.verification: A host unit test passes when writing a value to IWDG_PR.PR sets the correct bits in the register array and returns the expected value.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall enable write access to IWDG_PR by writing 0x00005555 to IWDG_KR.KEY before modifying the prescaler value.
requirements.verification: A host unit test passes when enabling write access sets the register array bits and verifies that subsequent writes to IWDG_PR.PR are accepted.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall disable write access to IWDG_PR by writing a value other than 0x00005555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: A host unit test passes when disabling write access clears the necessary internal flags and prevents further writes to IWDG_PR.PR.

requirements.statement: While no LL function has been called after reset, the IWDG LL driver shall not write any IWDG register, including IWDG_PR.PR.
requirements.verification: A target robot test passes when it checks that registers remain unchanged after reset sequence and before any function is invoked.
